I can’t generate the SOAP note because the transcript and DDx were not provided. Please paste both inputs so I can synthesize them.

Required inputs
- Raw transcript of the visit (conversation between clinician and patient). Paste the full text between the markers exactly as in your prompt.
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON provided by the diagnostic agent.

Optional but helpful
- Any explicit vitals, exam findings, or test results not in transcript/DDx.
- Preferred patient identifiers (or confirm de-identification).

How to provide
- Reply with the transcript between <<< and >>> and the DDx JSON between <<< and >>> (as in your original instruction).
- Example:
<<<
[Insert transcript here]
>>>
<<<
{"ddx":[{"condition":"Acute sinusitis","likelihood":"possible"}, {"condition":"Allergic rhinitis","likelihood":"less likely"}]}
>>>

When you provide those, I will produce a concise, structured SOAP note that follows your exact formatting and rules.
